# hermes-lcm v1.0.0-rc.4

A maintained-fork release candidate synchronizing upstream installation and
schema fixes. This is a prerelease; it does not resolve every open upstream issue.

## Highlights

- Synchronize upstream main through a13e709 (PRs #632, #623 and #624).
- Ship the Android-only fastembed dependency exclusion previously applied locally.
- Preserve supported desktop/server embedding behavior and profile-scoped settings.

## Changes

- Keep the fork's existing virtual-project metadata, scanner-safe redaction fixture
  and flat evidence tool schema while recording the upstream merge ancestry.
- Retain rc.3's #666 reasoning accounting, #667 profile isolation and #662 bounded
  SQLite finalization fixes; no replay or history rewrite is required.
- Add environment-marker regression coverage and refresh managed-update guidance.
- Keep optional evidence/embedding behavior opt-in. No compaction-threshold changes,
  new database schema, provider changes or experimental async compaction activation.

## Upgrade and rollback

Use the managed Hermes plugin update path after reviewing the scan. Preserve a
consistent SQLite backup plus old code and PM generation for rollback. Stop all
writers before any database restoration and keep matching WAL/SHM generations.
No database restoration is needed merely to revert this packaging-only code delta.

## Contributors

Thanks to upstream contributors and reporters, and to the maintained wzgrx fork.
